regression.fix: Require independently downloaded exact bytes and complete unique same-scope message/share agreement; retain content_conflict using the existing irreversible conflict flag after the existing authority checks.
regression.unknown_distinction: Missing, duplicate-pagination, malformed, incomplete, inexact, cancelled or transport-failed observations do not alone establish a conflict.
